meta_description:
1,068 likes, 45 comments - sjanaelise on October 21, 2026: "Girl to girl, becoming stupidly hot, wildly embodied and radically abundant is also a spiritual practice. 
Stop romanticising struggle and start questioning why you think you have to work so hard to deserve good things.

Embodiment. Self-worth. Receiving. Expansion.
Pleasure. Money. Love. Abundance.
It’s all ENERGY. 

Or are we still pretending wanting money makes us less spiritual? 👀😜

let yourself want more wild child 🐆💋
what are you learning to receive?".
